business_goals.name: Address physician burnout · improve retention
business_goals.strategic_context: Physician shortage acute. Burnout-driven attrition costing $400K-$1.2M per departing physician. Documentation burden cited as #1 driver.

business_goals.name: Restore margin · accelerate financial recovery
business_goals.strategic_context: Post-COVID financial recovery slow. Operating margin still below pre-2020. Revenue cycle leakage a major lever.

business_goals.name: Improve clinical outcomes · reduce avoidable readmissions
business_goals.strategic_context: Value-based care contracts make readmissions a direct financial liability. Quality metrics also tied to reimbursement.

business_goals.name: Build safe AI capability foundation
business_goals.strategic_context: HIPAA + emerging AI regulation + clinical safety bar means AI rollouts can't move fast without governance. Foundation prevents future debt.

initiatives.name: Clinical Documentation Copilot
initiatives.description: Ambient AI scribe (Nuance DAX or equivalent) deployed to physicians. Strongest qualitative impact in the portfolio — physician satisfaction is the #1 board-level metric. Expansion to remaining 5 hospitals planned for FY26.
initiatives.aligned_rationale: Flagship initiative. #1 board-level metric (physician satisfaction). Single largest qualitative impact in the portfolio. Anchor of physician retention thesis.

initiatives.name: Vibe Coding Rollout for IT
initiatives.description: Cursor (vibe coding) deployed to platform engineering team. Pilot scoped to non-PHI codebases initially. Expansion to clinical-adjacent codebases gated on CISO review of code-leak risk.
initiatives.stage_detail: 24 of 180 IT engineers · non-PHI codebases only
initiatives.status_summary: Pilot · early signals positive · CISO review pending for clinical-adjacent expansion

initiatives.name: Autonomous Helpdesk via ServiceNow
initiatives.description: ServiceNow Now Assist for IT helpdesk. Auto-resolution of password resets, access requests, basic config issues. Currently in P-DUPL-2026-02 pressure due to overlap with M365 Copilot. ServiceNow renewal Q4 2026.
initiatives.stage_detail: IT support only · expanding to clinical IT requests
initiatives.status_summary: Duplication conflict with M365 Copilot · attribution loose · ServiceNow renewal Q4

initiatives.name: Epic AI for Revenue Cycle
initiatives.description: Epic AI features for revenue cycle: prior auth automation, denial prediction, claim scrubbing. Tied directly to margin recovery thesis (post-COVID financial recovery). Performance currently below target but trajectory positive.
initiatives.aligned_rationale: Direct margin recovery lever. Single largest non-platform AI investment. Tied to board-level financial recovery thesis.

initiatives.name: Clinical Risk Stratification ML
initiatives.description: Risk stratification models for inpatient population. Live system-wide. Mature program; mostly maintenance + incremental model updates. Strong outcomes attribution.

initiatives.name: Joule (SAP) Pilot for Finance
initiatives.description: SAP Joule for finance team workflows. The 'Joule rollout' referenced in current Tower pressure cards (P-VALUE-2026-05). Value lag attributed to slower-than-planned RPA pipeline migration. Re-baseline expected at next governance review.
initiatives.status_summary: Committed $3.2M annual; measured $1.4M after 9 months · re-baseline pending

initiatives.name: Model Governance & FinOps Platform
initiatives.description: Platform investment for AI cost attribution + model governance. The 'Agent platform foundation' referenced in current Tower strategic bets. Won't show measured value until programs migrate onto platform.
initiatives.status_summary: Foundation phase · attribution coverage low · platform under construction
